name: Kimou Environmental Holding Limited
summary: Kimou Environmental Holding Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the development and operation of surface treatment recycling eco-industrial parks in the People's Republic of China. It operates in three segments: Rental and Facilities Usage; Wastewater Treatment and Utilities; and Sales of Goods and Ancillary Business. The company engages in industrial park property development and management; operates electroplating wastewater treatment plants; and provides utilities services. It also sells raw materials, consumables, precious metals, main metal salts, and chemical materials. In addition, the company provides centralized wastewater treatment services.
